^TNX.name: 10-Yr US Treasury Yield
^TNX.description: Benchmark risk-free rate dictating discount rates and consumer borrowing costs.
^TNX.transmission: Rising yields increase the discount rate on future earnings (compressing high-P/E growth stocks) while boosting bank Net Interest Margins. Falling yields unleash equity valuation multiple expansion.

bull_sectors.reason: Expanding net interest margin on lending books
Associated with economic expansion and commodity inflation

bear_sectors.reason: High debt service and competition with higher bond yields
Bond-proxy dividend yields lose relative appeal

DX-Y.NYB.name: US Dollar Index (DXY)
DX-Y.NYB.description: Measures USD purchasing power against major global currencies (EUR, JPY, GBP, CAD).
DX-Y.NYB.transmission: A strengthening Dollar tightens global financial conditions, denting multinational foreign revenues and commodity prices. A softer Dollar fuels rallies in Gold, Emerging Markets, and Big Tech.

bull_sectors.reason: Pure US domestic revenue, insulated from foreign currency translation
Cheaper foreign import goods reduce cost of goods sold

bear_sectors.reason: Global commodities priced in USD become more expensive overseas

CL=F.name: WTI Crude Oil
CL=F.description: Prime industrial commodity and prime driver of headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) volatility.
CL=F.transmission: Surging oil acts as a direct consumer tax, increasing airline, logistics, and manufacturing costs. Plunging oil frees consumer disposable cash and dramatically expands logistics margins.

bull_sectors.reason: Direct upstream cash flow generation and dividend expansion
Drilling, capex, and equipment utilization surge

bear_sectors.reason: Jet fuel represents 25-35% of total airline operating expenses
Higher pump prices cannibalize discretionary retail spending

GC=F.name: Gold (COMEX)
GC=F.description: Historical monetary anchor and supreme hedge against negative real rates and sovereign debasement.
GC=F.transmission: Gold surges when real yields fall or geopolitical and fiscal risks escalate. Soft gold reflects confidence in fiat stability and risk-seeking capital deployment.

bull_sectors.reason: Operating leverage to spot gold price appreciation
Broad commodity and hard asset revaluation

bear_sectors.reason: Flight-to-safety flows indicate sovereign or banking stress

^VIX.name: CBOE Volatility Index (VIX)
^VIX.description: 30-day implied volatility of the S&P 500, measuring market fear and options hedging demand.
^VIX.transmission: Sub-16 VIX signals positive dealer gamma (market makers dampen volatility by buying dips). VIX > 20 signals negative gamma, where institutional hedging accelerates market drawdowns.

bull_sectors.reason: Inelastic consumer demand and defensive corporate balance sheets
Reliable cash flow and low economic cyclicality

bear_sectors.reason: Multiples compress rapidly as volatility-targeting funds de-risk

active_regime.name: Deflationary / Risk-Off De-Leveraging
active_regime.description: Both Growth and Inflation/Yields are decelerating amid elevated volatility (VIX > 21). Institutional de-risking pulls equity multiples, bond yields, and cyclical commodities lower simultaneously, sparking a flight to safety in sovereign bonds, gold, and defensive cash-flow sectors.
active_regime.driver_summary: Volatility Shock (VIX: 25.64) & Equity Drawdown (SPY 1D: +0.31%, 20D: -5.56%) paired with falling 10Y Yields (-7.34% 20D) and Crude Oil (-1.64% 20D).
